meta.description: Rolls up the end of paths into a flat coil, like the crozier of a fern. The coil lies in the plane the path already bends in and gets tighter towards the tip. Every segment keeps its length, and the paths that grow on a rolled path are rolled up with it.

plant.description: The paths to roll up. Only the deepest depth levels roll (the last level by default), the others are passed on.

roll.description: How much of a path is rolled up, as a share of its length from the tip: 0 leaves it as it is, 0.5 rolls up its outer half, 1 all of it. Going down it unrolls from the base of the coil, the tip stays curled the longest. Read once per path, so a path_info with grown lets a frond unroll as it grows.

turns.description: How tight the coil is: how often a path turns around when all of it is rolled up. A path rolled up half as far turns half as often, with the same curl at its tip. A negative value rolls against the bend of the path.

depth.description: On which layers of paths to work, counted from the deepest. 2 rolls up the fronds together with their pinnae.
